# openmetadata_data_asset (Data Source)

Fetches the current metadata of an existing OpenMetadata data asset (a table, topic, dashboard, container, ...) by type and fully qualified name, e.g. an asset created by an ingestion pipeline.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current metadata of an ingested table.
data "openmetadata_data_asset" "orders" {
  type                 = "table"
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.analytics.public.orders"
}

output "orders_description" {
  value = data.openmetadata_data_asset.orders.description
}

output "orders_owners" {
  value = data.openmetadata_data_asset.orders.owners
}

output "orders_tags" {
  value = data.openmetadata_data_asset.orders.tags
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the asset, e.g. `my_service.my_db.public.orders` for a table.
- `type` (String) Type of the data asset: one of `api_collection`, `api_endpoint`, `chart`, `container`, `dashboard`, `dashboard_data_model`, `database`, `database_schema`, `ml_model`, `pipeline`, `search_index`, `stored_procedure`, `table`, `topic`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the asset.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains the asset belongs to.
- `extension_json` (String) Custom property values of the asset as a JSON object; null when none are set.
- `glossary_terms` (List of String) Fully qualified names of all glossary terms on the asset.
- `id` (String) UUID of the asset.
- `name` (String) Name of the asset.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of the asset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `tags` (List of String) Fully qualified names of all classification tags on the asset, whether applied manually, by auto classification or derived.

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
